007package com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent;
008
009import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
010
011/**
012 * Typed parameters for a {@code SET_EXECUTION_STATE} operation.
013 *
014 * <p>The database identifies the target run with {@code conversation_id}.
015 * This model requires that identifier explicitly, so the SDK never relies on
016 * the current database session conversation.</p>
017 *
018 * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/SetTeamExecutionStateSample.html">
019 *      SetTeamExecutionStateSample source</a>
020 * @since 1.1.0
021 */
022public final class ExecutionStateParams {
023    /** JSON mapper used to serialize the typed conversation parameter. */
024    private static final ObjectMapper MAPPER = new ObjectMapper();
025
026    /** Explicit database conversation identifier. */
027    private final String conversationId;
028
029    private ExecutionStateParams(Builder builder) {
030        this.conversationId = builder.conversationId;
031    }
032
033    /**
034     * Creates a builder for execution-state parameters.
035     *
036     * @return mutable builder for execution-state parameters
037     */
038    public static Builder builder() {
039        return new Builder();
040    }
041
042    /**
043     * Creates parameters for one database conversation.
044     *
045     * @param conversationId database-created conversation identifier
046     * @return immutable execution-state parameters
047     * @throws IllegalArgumentException when the identifier is null or blank
048     */
049    public static ExecutionStateParams forConversationId(String conversationId) {
050        return builder().conversationId(conversationId).build();
051    }
052
053    /**
054     * Returns the database conversation identifier.
055     *
056     * @return database conversation identifier
057     */
058    public String getConversationId() {
059        return conversationId;
060    }
061
062    /**
063     * Returns the JSON object passed to the database package.
064     *
065     * @return JSON object containing {@code conversation_id}
066     */
067    public String toParamsJson() {
068        return MAPPER.createObjectNode()
069                .put("conversation_id", conversationId)
070                .toString();
071    }
072
073    /** Builder for immutable execution-state parameters. */
074    public static final class Builder {
075        /** Explicit database conversation identifier. */
076        private String conversationId;
077
078        private Builder() {
079        }
080
081        /**
082         * Sets the database conversation identifier.
083         *
084         * @param conversationId database-created conversation identifier
085         * @return this builder
086         * @throws IllegalArgumentException when the identifier is null or blank
087         */
088        public Builder conversationId(String conversationId) {
089            if (conversationId == null || conversationId.isBlank()) {
090                throw new IllegalArgumentException("conversationId must not be null or blank");
091            }
092            this.conversationId = conversationId;
093            return this;
094        }
095
096        /**
097         * Builds immutable execution-state parameters.
098         *
099         * @return immutable execution-state parameters
100         * @throws IllegalArgumentException when no conversation identifier was supplied
101         */
102        public ExecutionStateParams build() {
103            if (conversationId == null) {
104                throw new IllegalArgumentException("conversationId must be provided");
105            }
106            return new ExecutionStateParams(this);
107        }
108    }
109}
